source.name: Knows When to Stop — 90-case synthetic healthcare administrative development dataset
source.notice: Ninety synthetic healthcare administrative cases in thirty families. Reviewed by AI adjudicators; see the release review records. No patient data or live systems; no human healthcare validation. This is a public development dataset, with no private test set or production healthcare validity claim. CMS fact context and synthetic local procedures are explicitly distinct. Fifteen case bodies in five retained families were used in previous public development experiments; seventy-five cases in twenty-five families are new. No HealthAdminBench data, case content, or model outcomes were imported.

build_plan.phase_policy: One phase per family from authoring-contract.json; all three variants use that phase.

data.local_policy: The current signed PMD order and current signed device-selection assessment must identify the same requested base before final transmission. Both are controlling records for their own fields; their differing document types do not establish precedence. Staff may copy agreed identifiers but may not change either signed record or select a different base. A discrepancy requires a signed reconciliation by the ordering practitioner. The queue inventory identifies all current orders, selections, and amendments.
